static_traits.name: Chen Siyuan
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone, raising a cat named Speckles
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with friends affected, reduced socializing due to avoiding going out
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems or treatment history in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe problems and trigger situations concretely; fairly cooperative; anxious and negative emotional tone; acknowledging avoidance of checking bills

basic_info.main_problem: Worrying about overspending due to liking shopping, being unable to pay credit card bills, and thus continuously producing finance-related anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because finance-related anxiety affects daily life and causes marked stress.

core_beliefs: I am unable to manage finances effectively
Serious consequences will occur once control is lost

special_situations.event: When experiencing tight work deadlines or feeling intense stress after work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not relieve stress through shopping, I cannot hold on; shopping is my only effective way to de-stress
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shopping after stress to seek emotional relief
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must buy something now to make myself feel better, otherwise I will collapse

special_situations.event: When thinking of or preparing to check bank/credit card statements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I see the real numbers, it proves I am completely out of control, and I will fall into worse debt afterwards
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding checking bills and account balances
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may not be able to pay off the bills, which will spiral beyond control

special_situations.event: When one overspending occurs after making a budget, or when facing the urge to buy non-essentials
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Either completely control spending, or be a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets an overly strict budget, self-blames after failure, and further relieves emotions through shopping
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As long as I cannot control myself this time, it means I am completely no good

special_situations.event: When friends invite one out or plan social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I go out I will definitely spend a lot of money, and finances will get worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Declines invitations and reduces meeting friends to avoid spending money
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Going out once will make the bills worse

core_conflict.wish: Being understood and supported under pressure, and able to safely express vulnerability and needs; hoping to regain a sense of control over finances and life
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged or humiliated after exposing financial difficulties; fearing loss of control and the serious consequences of worsening debt
defense_goal: Lowering anxiety by avoiding (not looking at bills, not talking about finances)
Keeps distance from friends to avoid being evaluated
Uses shopping to temporarily control emotions and maintain surface stability

object_relations.self_representation: Ashamed and not understood, a person who may lose control
object_relations.object_representation: 他人(朋友)是潜在的评判者或not理解者

manifestations: 因担心花钱而Reduced socializing,避免与朋友外出
感到Loneliness时以购物缓解情绪
Feels embarrassed and hesitant about confiding financial difficulties to friends

contact_model.definition: An individual restraining the impulse to do something to another person or thing, or giving up seeking others to do something for oneself and doing it to oneself instead — turning the libidinal energy directed outward toward oneself.
manifestations: 在会谈中表示尚not yet向最好的朋友谈及财务困扰,选择独自承受
把向外求助的冲动转为自我克制(not外出,not社交)

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 在对话中认为'朋友not理解我',因而回避与朋友接触和谈论问题

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Expresses embarrassment and self-blame in the session, worries that talking about financial problems will lead to being looked down on
Scrutinizes one's own consumption with harshness and caution, hesitates to take action

positive_force: Has a close friend to confide in; has potential social support
能够觉察trigger因素(Work压力,Loneliness)与回避行为(not看账单)
Has tried budgeting and cutting expenses; has some motivation to change
negative_force: 将购物作为主要情绪调节方式(压力与Loneliness后的情绪性消费)
回避查看银行/信用卡账单,短期减轻但长期加重Anxiety与失控感
灾难化,非黑即白,过度概括等认知偏差加剧财务Anxiety
High deadline pressure at work and lack of financial knowledge
因担心花钱而Social withdrawal,Reduced emotional support

antecedent: Feeling intense stress after work or when facing urgent work deadlines
target_behavior.core_reason: 将购物作为缓解压力与Loneliness的主要方式,伴随对失控与债务的灾难化认知
target_behavior.function: Gains immediate emotional relief and self-soothing
target_behavior.consequence: 信用卡余额上升,财务Increased stress;Anxiety持续;Relationship with friends affected;睡眠与饮食被扰;Mild decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids checking bank / credit card statements
antecedent: 想到或准备查看账单时产生强烈Anxiety
Noticing the credit card balance increasing
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕面对'失控/严重后果'的结果,认为查看账单会带来hard to bear的Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避not适与Anxiety,暂时维护心理舒适
target_behavior.consequence: without法准确掌握财务状况,缺乏计划性,决策失控,长期Anxiety worsened
